differential.name: End-stage renal disease on hemodialysis
differential.rationale: Advanced CKD (stage 4) with recent pre‑post dialysis weight change indicates chronic dialysis dependence.

differential.name: Acute decompensated heart failure
differential.rationale: History of chronic CHF and ischemic heart disease; fluid shifts from dialysis can precipitate volume overload and dyspnea.

differential.name: Hypoglycemia secondary to antidiabetic therapy
differential.rationale: Low serum glucose (65 mg/dL) in a diabetic on dialysis suggests reduced gluconeogenesis or excess insulin/sulfonylurea effect.

differential.name: Dialysis‑related hypotension / intradialytic hemodynamic instability
differential.rationale: Weight loss of 1.4 kg per session and pain score 4/10 are compatible with intradialytic cramps and low‑BP episodes.

differential.name: Infection/sepsis (e.g., catheter‑related)
differential.rationale: Elderly, immunocompromised CKD patients are at high risk; nonspecific pain and low‑grade symptoms may herald early infection.
